title: SavedLocation
description: A place an account asks about. The label is what the person calls it, not what a geocoder returned.

label.description: What the person calls this place.

timezone.description: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Istanbul. Never a fixed offset, which would be wrong twice a year.

is_current.description: The device's own position. At most one per account, enforced by the database rather than by whoever writes the next handler.

sort_order.description: Where it sits in the user's own ordering.

updated_at.description: The field conflicts are resolved on (ADR-0015).
